selection: Highest minimum seed daily mean log return; one finalist; cash benchmark=0; if no candidate admissible select BASE as diagnostic reference only

families.A: Past-only pooled AR forecast and distributional option expectation with 10% funding uncertainty reserve
families.B: Choose long underlying for call direction or debit vertical/long option by expected net value per paid dollar; no shorts
families.C: 45 DTE 1-sigma OTM instead of 21 DTE 1.7 sigma OTM
families.D: Reject >10% spreads, >30s ages or insufficient displayed depth; FOK at ask
families.E: 35% net take profit/stop and past-only invalidation; integer partial only with >=2 lots
families.F: At most four positions, factor cap .25 and open risk .008, never raises original limits

model: Same AR+Student-t+jump spot generator family as previous experiment, fixed regime fractions .57/.714; calendars from Alpaca. No future regime indicator exposed. European valuation proxy, no actual OPRA quotes.
execution: Synthetic ask entry/bid liquidation plus .65 per contract per side; stock10bps and zero share commissions assumption; entry at09:45 ET, monitoring10:00 and15min beforeclose; max72h exit known from calendar; no midpoint or automatic limit fills.
inference: Family-adjusted one-sided paired block-bootstrap daily log-return improvement, blocks3/5/10 sessions; estimate effective n, MDE and block/seed limitations. DSR diagnostic not acceptance. Five generated paths insufficient to infer real market probability.
stop: 14 fixed configurations, no extra search, no seed replacement; terminal holdouts generated only after finalist hash frozen
external: OPRA denied by entitlement; no account permissions endpoint exposed; no broker orders authorized
